definitionZh: CSS伪类之前的 :目标- 在滚动标记组中选择在活动滚动标记(目前匹配:目标-当前)之前的滚动标记. 您可以使用此选择器来样式显示当前滚动标记组中导航位置之前的导航项目。
sourceDefinition: The :target-before CSS pseudo-class selects scroll markers that come before the active scroll marker (the one that currently matches :target-current) within a scroll marker group. You can use this selector to style navigation items that come before the current navigation position within a scroll marker group.
